title: Kinetic-Hessian rank and ghost or strong-coupling obligation
hypothesis: A structural kinetic-Hessian obligation set can distinguish a declared degenerate constrained fixture from wrong-sign, rank-changing, or undeclared kinetic sectors before any local stability or physical-validity claim advances.
null_or_failure: A wrong-sign kinetic mode passes, Hessian rank changes without a boundary flag, degeneracy is equated with health, constraint count is undeclared, a zero eigenvalue is interpreted without a strong-coupling warning, dimensions fail, or a synthetic pass becomes empirical GMUT evidence.
test_falsifier_or_gate: Exercise positive, wrong-sign, singular-declared, singular-undeclared, rank-jump, constraint-mismatch, dimension-mismatch, and empirical-promotion fixtures; reject every missing obligation while real-data and likelihood counts remain zero.
rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the invalid fixture, retain the counterexample, reduce wording to a typed research scaffold, and require theory-specific Hamiltonian analysis, well-posedness work, and real observations before promotion.
boundary: Kinetic-Hessian fixtures are structural obligations, not proof of a healthy theory or empirical GMUT evidence.
